summary: Leashed dogs are welcome, including at the beach.

excerpts.quote: Your four-legged friends are welcome in Rouge National Urban Park.
As a courtesy to other visitors, please keep your dog on a leash, even at the beach.

dogRules.text: Keep dogs leashed, even at the beach.
Stay on marked trails; dogs can provoke black bears.
